method.baseline: normal pack IDs, isolated empty profiles/settings, learned rules and vision off; no corrections applied
method.confidence_denominator: active catalog image entries, including cut variants and generated atlases; excludes UNUSED/MISSING; not source-image accuracy
method.elapsed_times: observed analysis wall times with mixed/warm caches; not cold performance measurements
method.held_out_status: not claimed: prior development use and paid status not established
method.sample: 28 top-down inputs plus two isometric extensions; convenience sample from the owner library, not a market survey
method.tier_3_star: existing layout/publisher heuristics; not an installed or validated profile
method.visual_scope: agent-reviewed fields and specific visible errors only; no owner approval or complete pack audit
method.visual_selection: up to four active entries per pack: lowest confidence, highest confidence, another role if available, then midpoint/next unused entry; largest source overview alongside
